description: External crates.io dependencies are held for at least 24h after publish to dodge fast-flagged supply-chain attacks; internal first-party (stSoftwareAU/*) deps are exempt.

Internal stSoftwareAU/* git deps bypass the wait — they are first-party releases. This repository currently has no internal git deps in Cargo.toml; the rule is kept so future internal deps inherit the bypass automatically.

Renovate is the defence-in-depth layer; bump-deps.sh also enforces the same window when it runs locally or on the per-PR dependency-bump path (the weekly upgrade-dependencies.yml cron was removed in Issue #1282).

Issue #1484: the markdownlint-cli2 npm tool is pinned inline in .github/workflows/markdown-lint.yml (no package.json manifest exists). A customManagers regex entry tracks that pin so Renovate keeps it current, and the npm packageRule below holds bumps for the same 24h quarantine window as every other external dependency.

Issue #1913: the CI spell-check job installs codespell from .github/requirements/codespell-requirements.txt with pip --require-hashes. The pip_requirements manager below tracks that file (its default file patterns do not cover .github/requirements/), and the pip packageRule holds bumps for the same 24h quarantine window.

Issue #1916: ORDERING IS LOAD-BEARING. Renovate merges packageRules in array order and the LAST matching rule wins, so the internal stSoftwareAU/* bypass MUST remain the final entry of packageRules — placed earlier, the manager-scoped rules that follow it (cargo, github-actions) silently override it back to 24h. Do not reorder packageRules without re-reading tests/issue_1916_renovate_rule_ordering.rs.

Issue #1916: source-URL matching uses matchSourceUrls with glob patterns. The predecessor key matchSourceUrlPrefixes was deprecated in favour of matchSourceUrls and removed in Renovate 40 — reintroducing it makes the rule a validation error or a silently non-matching no-op.

Issue #1916: the renovate-validate workflow runs renovate-config-validator on every PR touching this file, so an invalid or migrated-away key fails CI instead of silently disabling a rule. The renovate CLI pin in that workflow is tracked by the customManager below.

customManagers.description: Track the markdownlint-cli2 version pinned inline in the markdown-lint workflow (Issue #1484).
Track the renovate CLI version pinned inline in the renovate-validate workflow (Issue #1916).

packageRules.description: External npm tools pinned in workflows (e.g. markdownlint-cli2): hold for 24h after publish (Issue #1484).
External PyPI tools pinned in .github/requirements (codespell): hold for 24h after publish (Issue #1913).
External crates.io dependencies: hold for 24h after publish.
Default cargo packages without an explicit source URL still get the quarantine window — minimumReleaseAge applies unless overridden by the internal bypass at the end of this array.
GitHub Actions: hold for 24h after publish, in addition to commit-SHA pinning (Issue #1216).

Internal stSoftwareAU/* deps bypass the quarantine — first-party releases. MUST STAY LAST: the last matching packageRule wins, so any manager-scoped rule placed after this one would override the bypass back to 24h (Issue #1916).
